title: Raise logit softcap 15 -> 30
description: One line in GPT.forward: softcap = 15 -> 30. Nothing else touched. val_bpb 0.990464 vs baseline 0.986277 (worse by 0.0042).
reflection:
NEGATIVE, and clearly outside noise: +0.0042 is ~4.6x the ~0.0009 noise floor. The run was a perfectly clean readout -- FLOPs/token 3.460347e8, params 71.3M, peak VRAM 32.9GB, MFU 38.55% vs 38.48%, and 332.1M tokens vs the baseline's 331.5M -- so the softcap model actually saw marginally MORE data and still lost. Zero compute confound; the whole gap is quality.

The diagnostic detail is that the smoothed TRAIN loss ended at ~2.769, essentially identical to the baseline's ~2.768, while val_bpb rose by 0.0042. Equal train loss and worse val loss is the signature of a regularizer being removed, not of an expressivity limit being lifted. So softcap = 15 is not merely an early-training stability guard as I argued in #83; it is doing real generalization work by capping how confident the model can become on a single epoch of data. My mechanism story (the cap binds late and taxes confident correct predictions) had the sign of the effect backwards: overconfidence costs more on val than the foregone confidence gains.

That also kills the follow-up I sketched -- removing the softcap entirely is strictly further in the direction that just lost, so nobody should buy it. If the axis is worth anything it points the other way (softcap 10), but at 3 runs left I would not spend one on it; the expected gain is a fraction of what 15 -> 30 lost, and there is a real chance 15 is already near the optimum.

Broader read for the cell: the output head is now measured and settled, as are batch size (r0), head split (r1), width (r4) and embedding capacity (r5). Depth is the only axis that ever paid and it has decayed to ~-0.001 per step. The untouched region is the attention window pattern, and the regularization framing above is a new reason to look there -- if this model is generalization-limited rather than capacity-limited on a single epoch, then knobs that change what the model can memorize matter more than knobs that change how much it can represent.
